about: Your friends keep sending you reels. You keep scrolling past them. Nudge reads your own chat exports and shows who has been reaching out while you weren't really there, as a short, kind to-do list for your friendships.

features.title: Reads it in your browser
features.body: Drop an Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger or Telegram export into the page: nothing is uploaded, and there's no account or server.

features.title: Who's waiting on you
features.body: A self-contained page with clickable links to every unanswered reel and a copy button for the opener.

features.title: A ready-to-send opener
features.body: Each friend comes with a kind line to restart the conversation.

features.title: No dragging after the first time
features.body: Connect your Downloads folder once in Edge or Chrome and Nudge picks up the newest exports by itself.

features.title: Share straight from WhatsApp
features.body: On Android, Export chat → nudge lands it in the app directly.

features.title: Mark as replied
features.body: Tap ✓ Replied as you catch up; if that friend messages again in a later export, they come back.

features.title: Keeps links, not messages
features.body: It remembers who-sent-what-when and links only, never message text, and only on your device.
